installer.scope: Real shipped scripts in isolated fixtures, including upgrade from the published 0.5.0-r2 artifact. No game-process mocks.

native.scope: NGX evaluate/output readback, dimensions, repeated init/shutdown, state restoration; exact DXGI proxy ordinary presentation, resize and release. Explicit standalone probe mode; gameplay FG modes are checked separately.

gameplay.playerResult: Player approved appearance and operation and authorized website publication.
gameplay.preCardFix: 2x, 3x, 4x and Off selected in gameplay; same final native renderer. The later managed change corrected only the displayed version.
gameplay.finalBuild: Final managed DLL loaded with all hooks ready; corrected 0.5.1 card observed. Fresh final runtime showed active DLAA and 2x generation with API/FG status zero.

dlss.status: DLSS DLAA GPU evaluated | 2560x1440 -> 2560x1440 | visual validation pending
dlss.note: Super Resolution/DLAA experimental integration; no frame generation. Runtime success does not establish correct moving-object motion vectors, UI separation or visual parity.

frameGeneration.note: SDK presents include generated frames; physical display pacing and moving-object/UI quality need player validation.

gameplay.scope: Integration and player smoke check; no controlled FPS benchmark or fresh final all-mode recording.

limitations: Broader hardware, long sessions, scene transitions, moving-object/UI quality and physical display pacing remain under review.
Normal user exit recorded a UnityPlayer.dll shutdown fault matching 18 earlier events since September 30. Root cause remains unproven; this release does not claim to fix it.
